# Fadi Mamar — Full-Stack, Mobile & AI Developer in Toronto

> Fadi Mamar is a Toronto-based full-stack and mobile developer, and founder of Mamar Group Ltd. He builds web applications, iOS and Android apps, and AI-powered products for startups and businesses across Canada and remotely worldwide.

## About

Fadi Mamar is a software developer based in Toronto, Canada. With an engineering background, he brings a methodical, architecture-first approach to every project. He specializes in full-stack web development, native mobile apps (iOS and Android), and AI-integrated applications. He is the founder of Mamar Group Ltd and is currently available for freelance and contract work.

## Services

- **AI Application Development**: Custom AI-powered tools, chatbots, and intelligent automation using OpenAI and Gemini APIs
- **Full-Stack Web Development**: Modern web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, and cloud infrastructure
- **Mobile App Development**: Native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) apps, plus cross-platform with React Native
- **Interactive UI & Animation**: High-performance animated interfaces with GSAP, scroll-driven effects, and immersive web experiences
- **Technical Consulting**: Architecture reviews, performance optimization, and technology strategy for startups and growing teams

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP
- **Mobile**: iOS (Swift, SwiftUI), Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), React Native
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, GraphQL
- **AI & ML**: OpenAI API, Gemini API
- **DevOps**: Docker, AWS, Git, CI/CD, Vercel

## Portfolio

- [Konstruction](https://konstruction.ca): Construction company website with project galleries, service pages, and location-based SEO pages. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- [VibeBot](https://vibebot.gg): AI-powered no-code Discord bot builder platform. Built with React, Node.js, Discord.js, and AI integrations.
- [Zentry Gaming](https://zentry.com): Award-winning animated website with scroll-triggered effects and immersive video storytelling. Built with React, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS.
- [Brainwave AI](https://app-brainwave.vercel.app): Modern AI landing page with parallax effects, bento box layouts, and smooth animations. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite.
